description: Landing page ('/') redesign. Rework src/components/AreaPicker.tsx: delete the inline header (now owned by global Header), convert its root <main> to <div>, add the editorial hero section with .hero-gradient + .eyebrow + .editorial-headline + three FloatingStatPill chips, restyle the 3-step journey as glass cards with hover elevation and connector lines, add section anchors (id='overview', id='presets', id='methodology'), restyle the search input with Clear button + spinner + arrow-key navigation on the hits dropdown, swap the preset tiles to data-active-styled glass cards, replace the size selector with <SegmentedControl>, polish the Ready-to-analyse CTA card with hover-translate on the arrow, upgrade the map wrapper to rounded-[32px] shadowed frame with a restyled instruction pill, and append a verbatim 2-paragraph methodology card (50/30/20 weights + 150m scenario tool with planting-suitability disclaimer per iteration-3 NIT #8). Edit src/components/AreaPickerMap.tsx only to add an inner-frame shadow overlay and `rounded-[inherit] overflow-hidden` on the outer <div>. Every state hook, effect, debounce, geocode fetch, jumpTo/pickCenter/start handler, cellsFor/isValidArea guard remains verbatim. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the SegmentedControl component, the global Header rendering, and the new design tokens/utilities).
